citations.claim: body1 starts fast moving toward body0
body0 x exceeds arena at final step, violation

counterfactual.change: Reduced body 1 initial vx from 27.7 to 5 to lower collision impulse; body0 never reaches boundary at high speed, so in_arena violation disappears.

explanation: Body 0 is initially stationary. Body 1 collides with it at step 26-27 at high speed (vx~27.7). The collision transfers ~30.6 m/s to body 0. Over steps 27-33 it travels to x~19.45, exceeding arena limit 20-r=19.198 by 0.25 (tolerance 0.15). Boundary collision fails to stop it; positional correction/impulse at the arena edge is insufficient for this numerically stiff high-velocity case, so body exits the arena.
vision_note: In steps 30-32 a blue and a red circle drift rightward just to the right of a vertical wall. At step 33 the red circle visibly crosses the right arena edge and sticks partly outside the frame.
